title: feat(spec)!: a seed is create-only by default — an omitted `mode` is `ignore`
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBP5K9Jq5fkZEQZP14zQ7EMz)_

Fixes #30081

Ruling-ref: 6631016988
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
ADR-0087: D3 semantic entry `seed-mode-default-create-only` (registered in the changeset). No D2 conversion: a compiled artifact's written `"mode": "upsert"` cannot be told from an authored one, so a package built before this change keeps today's replay until it is rebuilt, and nothing converts it. An `os package install` keeps the installed body in its install ledger and its sample-data reseed replays that body, so such an install keeps overwriting on reseed until the rebuilt artifact is re-installed. A stored `seed` metadata item with no `mode` is not rewritten: its next publish parses it to `ignore`, with no signal.
Skills-docs: owed — the skills lane is paused and `skills/**` is Tier H, so this PR does not edit it. Owed lines: `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md:36` (a demo dataset taught as `mode: 'upsert'`), `:52` and `:63` (`upsert` named the default), `:160` ("Default to `upsert`"); `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json:37` (an `applyOn: 'create'` column on a dataset with no mode, which now changes nothing); `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:377` (`upsert` default). `seeds.md:26` (reference data declaring `upsert`) stays correct.
Prior rulings read: seed,seedmode,applyon → 18 ADR hits (`check-prior-rulings --card 30081`); none rules on a seed's `mode` default. ADR-0057 D6 and ADR-0066 D5 cover the boot reconcile of stack-declared roles, units and policies, a separate path from `SeedSchema` datasets; ADR-0131 retired per-organization platform seeding and leaves the per-organization replay of an app's datasets as it was, which now follows the same default. Governing: maintainer ruling 6631016988 on this card (measure production first, then option A) and the seat's contract look 6633227800. Also read: #25761 (`columns.FIELD.applyOn`), kept as the escape for an `upsert` dataset. Thread: 6 comments, 0 ruling-shaped by first line; ruling 6631016988 read by hand. Repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：种子数据集不写 `mode` 时，默认值从 `upsert` 改为 `ignore`（只插入缺失的行，不改已有行）；`SeedLoaderConfig.defaultMode` 直接就是这个字段，六处重放调用点不再各自写死 `'upsert'`；CRM、showcase、todo 三个示例共 24 个业务数据集去掉了显式 `upsert`。
- 为什么改：生产实测（评论 6633189577）证明，`os start`/`os serve` 每次重启、启动产物升级、`os package install` 升级，都会把客户对种子行的修改静默改回出厂值；按裁决 6631016988 选 A。
- 风险与回滚：这是破坏性改动。依赖重放刷新的数据集需要显式写 `mode: 'upsert'`；改动前构建的包产物里已写死 `"mode":"upsert"`，重新构建前仍按旧行为重放（不做猜测式转换）；用 `os package install` 装过的包还要用新产物重新安装，否则其 reseed 仍会覆盖。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts` 的 `mode` 字段、`packages/runtime/src/seed-default-create-only-replay.integration.test.ts`，以及下面的普查表。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/runtime && npx vitest run --project local src/seed-default-create-only-replay.integration.test.ts`（真实 SQLite 驱动：修改保留、缺行补插、未动行 `updated_at` 不变；显式 upsert 对照组仍回写）。
- 需要你做的：Skills-docs 行列出的 `skills/**` 几行待技能通道恢复后补改；其余无需操作。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`.** `SeedSchema.mode` defaults to `ignore`. The loader already treats `ignore` as create-only, so no mode value is added: a replay inserts a record whose row is missing and leaves an existing row as it is. The `mode` describe and TSDoc say so, name `mode: 'upsert'` (with `columns: { FIELD: { applyOn: 'create' } }`) as the way to keep reference data current, and state the compiled-artifact disposition. `SeedLoaderConfig.defaultMode` is now `SeedSchema.shape.mode` itself, so the default is stated once. Three `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR[18]` rows (`Seed:mode`, `SeedLoaderConfig:defaultMode`, `SeedLoaderRequest:config`) and the D3 semantic entry `seed-mode-default-create-only` declare the move. The authorable-defaults projection and the generated reference pages follow from the build.
- **The six replay sites stop restating `defaultMode: 'upsert'`:** `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` (the per-organization replayer, the inline boot seed and the dev hot reload), `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` (`applyPublishedSeeds`), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts`, and `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` (`runInlineSeed`: install, reseed and the rehydrate healer). The save door (`protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`) reads the schema's default for a seed item that declares no mode, instead of its own `'upsert'` fallback.
- **Census (below):** the reference apps' business datasets drop their explicit `mode: 'upsert'`. Each file says why it declares no mode, and that `os dev --fresh` is how a seed edit is seen again.
- **Docs:** the seed-data guide leads with the create-only default, moves `upsert` to reference data, and carries a callout on packages built before the change. The getting-started example and the stack's `data` docblock follow.
- **Changeset:** minor for `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/cloud-connection`. It carries BREAKING; before and now; compiled artifacts, installed packages and stored `seed` items; and the remedy (rebuild, re-install what `os package install` installed, purge then reseed to get the shipped values back).
- **Install-local reseed docblock:** it no longer promises "a clean baseline back after editing demo rows". A reseed puts back missing rows in each dataset's stored mode; purge first to reset edited rows.

### Phase 1 measurement (comment 6633189577, `f68b47ca`, before any change)

A seed dataset with no `mode`; a customer `PATCH` to a seeded row; then a replay. Every boot ran the built CLI with `NODE_ENV` unset, which the CLI defaults to production.

| Path | After the replay |
|:--|:--|
| `os start --artifact`, restart on the same home | edit overwritten (`updated: 1`) |
| `os serve`, restart | edit overwritten |
| boot artifact 1.0.0 → 1.1.0 | edit overwritten |
| `os package install` 1.0.0, edit, then 1.1.0 | edit overwritten (`inline seed … updated=1`) |
| that runtime restarted (rehydrate) | edit kept: no seed runs |

No signal reached the customer: the replay logs at `info` under a `warn` default, the banner reads `Seeds: … 2 rows`, and the install prints nothing about rewritten rows.

### Census: in-tree seeds that relied on the overwrite

| Seed | Datasets | Before | Now | Reason |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `examples/app-crm/src/data/index.ts` | accounts, contacts, opportunities, leads, activities (5) | `mode: 'upsert'` | no mode (create-only) | The customer's business data: the card's own reproduction, and the seat's contract look names it. |
| `examples/app-showcase/src/data/seed/index.ts` | accounts, contacts, inquiries, products, projects, tasks, categories, businessUnits, orgUnits (`sys_business_unit`), teams, fieldZoo, invoices, invoiceLines, expenseReports, expenseLines, preferences, announcements, clientBriefs (18) | `mode: 'upsert'` | no mode | The demo workspace's business data, which a user edits once it is seeded. `orgUnits` is environment-owned admin data by its own comment; its fixed ids, which metadata references, are still inserted when missing. `memberships` already declared `ignore` and is unchanged. |
| `examples/app-todo/src/data/index.ts` | tasks (1) | `mode: 'upsert'` | no mode | The user's own tasks. |
| Kept as `upsert` | none | | | No in-tree dataset is reference data the package must keep refreshed. |
| Platform packages, plugins, services, `create-objectstack` templates | none | | | No `defineSeed` / `SeedSchema.parse` dataset ships outside `packages/spec` itself and the three examples. |
| Test fixtures, unchanged | `packages/cli/test/fixtures/option-b-collection-zoo.ts:246`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/seed-ownership-claim-dispatch.dogfood.test.ts:72` | `mode: 'upsert'` | unchanged | They declare the mode they test. Loader tests that pass a raw `defaultMode: 'upsert'` with unparsed datasets pin upsert replay and are unchanged; their comments that claimed to mirror the AppPlugin request now say what that request is. |

## Tests

- **Real driver** (`packages/runtime/src/seed-default-create-only-replay.integration.test.ts`, new). `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3) under `ObjectQL`. The request is built as every replay site now builds it: parsed, with no mode of its own. A first version is loaded, a customer edits one row, then a second version replays (it changes the edited row's value and an untouched row's value, and adds a record). With no mode: the edit survives, the added record is inserted, and the untouched row keeps its value and its `updated_at` (`Date` faked per step, so the stamps differ). Control, `mode: 'upsert'` declared: the shipped value is written back over the edit and onto the untouched row, whose `updated_at` moves.
  - Ablation: with the default put back to `upsert`, the default arm fails (`expected 2 to be 0` updates) and the parse case fails (`expected 'upsert' to be 'ignore'`); the control still passes.
- **Install-local reseed** (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-reseed.test.ts`). It captures the request the reseed hands the loader and parses it with the real `SeedLoaderRequestSchema`. A mode-less dataset arrives as `ignore`, a declared `upsert` stays `upsert`, and the config carries no `defaultMode`. The heal test stops expecting the restated `defaultMode: 'upsert'`.
  - Ablation: with `defaultMode: 'upsert'` restored in `runInlineSeed`, both the reseed pin and the heal test fail.
- **Boot inline seed** (`packages/runtime/src/seed-datasets.test.ts`, round 1). A single-tenant boot's inline seed hands the loader a multi-pass request with no `defaultMode`. The per-organization replayer and the install-local doors are pinned the same way.
  - Ablation: with `defaultMode: 'upsert'` restored at `app-plugin.ts`'s inline config, it fails (`expected { multiPass: true, …(2) } to not have property "defaultMode"`).
- **Spec:** an omitted mode parses to `ignore`; every authored mode parses as written; `SeedLoaderConfig.defaultMode` equals the seed default; a mode-less dataset in a parsed `SeedLoaderRequest` reaches the loader as `ignore`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Compiled artifacts (finding, as the contract look asked).** `os build` writes the parsed seed into `dist/objectstack.json`, default included, so every package built before this PR ships `"mode": "upsert"` and keeps overwriting until it is rebuilt. The loader cannot tell that value from an authored one, so nothing converts it (contract look item 3). This is why the changeset's remedy leads with "rebuild". A follow-up could stop `os build` from writing a seed's defaulted `mode` into the artifact, so a future default move reaches a package without a rebuild; that is outside this card's scope.
- **Installed packages (round 1).** The install-local ledger keeps the body as installed (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, rehydrate and `seedDatasetsOf(entry.manifest)`). Only the sample-data reseed replays it against existing rows, in the body's stored mode. A pre-change install keeps overwriting there until the rebuilt artifact is re-installed; a post-change install reseeds create-only. The rehydrate seeds nothing, the heal seeds only when every seeded object is empty, and the per-organization replay runs only for a new organization, so none of them overwrites. To get the shipped values back over edits: purge, then reseed.
- **Stored `seed` items (round 1).** A `sys_metadata` seed item with no `mode` is replayed on its next publish (`protocol-publish-batch.ts`). It now parses to `ignore`, so that publish inserts only missing rows. Nothing is rewritten and nothing signals it; the changeset and the D3 reason say so.
- **What create-only gives up.** A value changed in a later seed version reaches only a row the load creates. A seed that relied on the overwrite to keep relative dates fresh (the CRM's `daysFromNow`/`daysAgo`) now resolves them once, at first insert. Each example file says so and points at `os dev --fresh`.
- **Per-organization replay** follows the same default with no change of its own (it already ran a parsed request), as the contract look scoped it.
- **Not in scope:** the `env` default.
